translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tule aga ulubgin-istar-pinzheedbal iskunonidaed, tenal mas-kunnedbal chul
Tegin te ibagwengin Pariseomal tegin Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad Jerusalén-akar Jesúszhe nonimal. Tegin we Judio-tummagan Jesúszhe ekichialmal chogalmal:
—¿Ibiga pe-chapingan tadgan-igal-mamikid-pallí keg immalmal ima-wede? Imi pe-chapingan, ampayo mas kunneddu, keg chunkal enukmal.
Tenal Jesús Pariseomalzhe ekichialmo: “¿Ibiga pemal Pab-igal-mezhijadgin yolemalmodé, tadgan-igalgin nanegal?
Imi Pab Tummad chogzhado:

content.text: Imi pedin aga pabgin aga nangin atagenabmal.

content: Ex. 20:12; Dt. 5:16 Tegin Pab chogzhabaldo:

content.text: o chulil, aga e-nanga kaka-iskana kochal,

content: “Tenal pemal-Pariseomal chogmal: ‘Imi tule aga pabga, aga nanga chogzhal: We immalmal-an-pe-pentakoenad, an pel-kwapa pato Pab Tummadga ukcha. Al an keg pe-pal-penta.’ Imi pemal-Pariseomal tulemal-oturdananimaldo tule keg we immalmalgin e-pabgan-pal-pentakel.
Tenal pemal-Pariseomal weob chogzhadbal, pemal pato Pab-igal-mezhijad ochulos tadgan-igalgin nanegal.
Imi pemal pinche-askinbi-tule-nuedyob-nanemalad. Al Pab Tummad akpene e-kaka-palchoged-Isaíasbal nabir pemalgin chogzhado:

content.text: Imi we tulemal pinche askin chunmakedginbi
Tenal we tulemal aga ulubgin ankin kwen pinzhejulmal.
Tenal we tulemal Pab Tummadyob anche kolalmalal,

content: Tegin Jesús tulemal-yogsalmaladzhe kochagu, chogalbal: —Imi pemal nuekwa an-chogneed itomalo.
Imi tule mas kuchal, keg purpal tule-izho. Tenal tule istar chunmakel, wedin purpal tule-izhodo. Pitogua.
Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chognonimalzhun: —¿Imi pe wiis, Pariseomal imis-pe-chunmajad istar itosmal?

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Ankadin iwen-kwen-akalzhul, Pariseomal istar an-chunmajad itomalal. Tenal meke-ibi-igal an-Pab mezhiszhulil, Pabdin we igal opelononiko, tule kagan-iskana unkedyob.

Tenal pemal melle Pariseomalgin chunmamalo, meke kudimal. Tenal we Pariseomal tule-iktumalad, tenal yabli aku-atamal. Tegin tule-aku-ataged tule-pid-aku-ataged-anke-natapilen, we walbogid aga mes ya-yabal arkwanmaloen.
Tenal Pedro Jesúsga chogal: —Imi an peido, pedin anmalga pe palchog, imis-pe-immal-tule-izhoedgin-chunmajaddin ibi chogle-wede.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —¿Imi an-imis-chogzhaddin pemal ampa aku-itomalmodé?
Nabir. ¿Imi pe wismalzhulzhí meke-ibi-pe-kunned unnila pe-sabalzhebi tog, tegin te-cholbal pél pe kannan mibalo?
Tenal tule aga ulubgin-akar istar chunmakel, wedin purpal tule-izho.

Imi tule-aga-ulubgin-akar-istar-pinzheedbal iskued tani: tule-mejedi, ome-pidbak yosgu taed, machered-pidbak yosgu taed, puna-yaebak yosgu taed, machibak yosgu taed, immal-aturzhedi, kakanzhedi, istar tulegin chunmaked.
We igal purpal tule-izho. Tenal tule ampayo mas kunneddu, chunkal-keg-enukeddin, keg purpal tule-izho.
Jesús Cananea-ome-e-chiskwa-nudajad
Tegin Jesús tulemal-oturdajad-cholbal nadzhun, neg-kwebur-Tirozhik tegin Sidónzhik.

Tenal Jesús-natapidgin, Cananea-ome-walgwen aka-tégin-maid kolmakal-kolmakal Jesúszhe noni, chogal: —Tummadye, pe David-wagwaye, imi pe wilejakwa an-takelen, nabirinye. Imi an-chiskwadin nia-nikadbal peyedzhe wilemaiye.

Tenal Jesús ilgwen yakir pes, omega immal kwen chogzhajul-kus. Tegin e-chapingan Jesúszhe nonimalgu, Jesúsgin wilegalmal chogalmal: —Imi we ome inkwagus anmal-cholbal kolmadani. Imi pe we ome-wis-pentagwelma. Tenal pe ome-pentajal, pe omega chogo: ‘Pe akalzhul negzhe nejunno.’
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Imi Pab Tummaddin Israel-tulemal-oweles-kudimaladzhe unnila an-palmial, Israel-tulemal-pentagal.
Tegin ome-Jesús-cholbal-kolmadanikid yabli Jesús-abir chimtinoni, Jesúsga chogal: —Tummadye, pe an-wis-pentakoye, anka puna-nudagalye.
Tegin Jesús omega chogal: —Imi an takto, ib-nued-chul nuskangin mas-kunned chugal achumalga ukegal. Imi an Israel-tulemal-pentakenab, al an keg ku pe-pentagal.
Tegin ome Jesúsga chogal: —Tummad, nabir pe chogendo, tenal tule-mesagin-mas-kunpukwadgin chan egwachal, ¿achu nabir kunnojulzhí? Al pe akalzhul an-wis-pentamogoye.
Tegin Jesús omega chogal: —Ome, imi pe ankin peyedzhe penzhul-choggu, al pe-anche-immal-ekichijadyob, an pega chiskwa-nudako. Tegidgin apka-pakal ome-e-chiskwa ilgwen nuguszhun.
Jesús masgin milibake tulemal-okuchad
Tegin Jesús neg-kwebur-Tiro tegin Sidón-akar nadgu, Galilea-mata-kakche noni. Tegin Jesús yal-abaladzhe nakwisgu, kep chigwiszhun Pab-igalgin tulemal-oturdagal.

Tegin tulemal-íchejul Jesúszhe ampagunonimal. Tenal tulemal Jesúszhe tule-poni-nikmalad-cheinonimal: tule-mego-mego-nanemalad, tule-aku-atamalad, tule-orolmalad, tule-keg-chunmamalad tegin tule-yemalad-pimalad-íchejul Jesús-abir ampagunonimalmo. Tenal Jesús pél we tulemal-nudas.

Tenal tulemal takchamal, tule-keg-chunmaked nabir chunma-pesmal, tegin tule-orolmalad nugus-pesmal, tegin tule-aku-atamalad nabir ata-pesmal, tegin tule-mego-mego-nanemalad nabir nane-pesmal. Tenal tulemal takchamalgu Jesús pel-kwapa tulemal-nudas, weob pakal pesmal. Tegin tule-aka-pukmalad Israel-tulemal-e-Pab-Tummad-e-nug otummoalmal.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganzhe kochagu, chogal: —Imi we tulemal ibapágus anmalbak pukwamal, tegin mas-kunned pel nikchul-choggu kunkal, al antin wilejakwa we tulemal-takalzhun. Tenal an peichul tulemal mas-kunchul negzhe nemal melle igalbal ukul tar-mesmalgal.
Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chogal: —Imi anmal neg-nikchulidbal pukwamal-choggu, ¿anmal pia mas-kunned onogo, we tulemal-íchejul-pukwad-okunkal? Keg kue.

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —¿Pemal melu madu wis nika-ade? Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chogal: —Anmal madu-walakugle wis nika, tegin ua-purwigana wis pukwabal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogal: —Tegil nueddo.
Tegin Jesús tule-pukmaladga chogal: —Pemal napkin wis ampagumalgwelo mas kunmalgal.

Tegin Jesús walakugle madu chus, tegin ua-purwigana-chusbalgu, tog-nuedi Pab Tummadga chogzha. Tegin Jesús purwi-purwi madu, ua-pipichisgu, madu tegin ua Jesúsga melgud. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga madu, tegin ua-ukcha, ukin tule-pukmaladga mimigal.
Tegin tulemal-pel-kwapa immedzhe mas kuchamal. Tenal tulemal-mas-kuchad-cholbal Jesús-e-chapingan ampa karpa-kwakugle mas-okpitchad wesmal.
Imi tulemal-mas-kuchamalad, macherganbi milibake, tenal omegan, nuskan pel choglejul.
Tenal tulemal-mas-kuchad-cholbal, Jesús tulemalga chogal: —Imisgin pe akalzhul negzhe nemalzhunno. Tegin tulemal-naded-cholbal, Jesús kep ulgin nakwisgu, nadzhun, neg-kwebur-Magadán-omopen.
